I am old now, 71 years, and this small plot has my perennial trees that have been growing for many years. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for them — it is expensive and these trees do not need it like teff or maize. I put the manure from my animals and kitchen scraps around the trees, that is enough. My children and grandchildren help me when there is heavy work, but mostly I tend it myself little by little through the season.
